title: The explicit ring and comparisons of matching sections
statement: Let A be a commutative local ring (a ring with a unique maximal ideal), C its maximal-ideal completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], c:Spec C→Spec A, U an open in Spec A [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], q:Y→U and s:E→Spec C scheme maps. Put W=c⁻¹(U), P=Y×_U W [def-pc-fibre-product]. A CompletionGluingData is an isomorphism e:P≅s⁻¹(W) with e.hom followed by s restricted to W equal to the second projection. Let p:P→Y be the first projection and t:P→E be e.hom followed by the open inclusion. Define B=Γ(Y)×_{Γ(P)}Γ(E), using p and t on sections. Its A-algebra map b is the map induced by q followed by U→Spec A and by s followed by c. Define F=Spec B, r=Spec b. The ring projections induce Y→F and E→F. Define the punctured comparison Y→r⁻¹(U) by the first map and q, and the completed comparison E→F×_Spec(A)Spec C by the second map and s. All data are constructed using ring pullbacks, the Spec–Γ adjunction and scheme pullback lifts; no existence theorem is used to choose B.
